newsitem.title: USA: D&P assigns Monsanto chemicals spin-off rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P assigns Monsanto chemicals spin-off rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it has assigned preliminary ratings for the yet-to-be-named chemicals business to be spun-off from Monsanto Co of triple-B for senior unsecured debt and D-two for commercial paper.
Ratings for the Monsanto life sciences business remain at single-A-plus for senior unsecured debt and D-one for commercial paper.
These rating actions follow discussions with management and finalization of a proposed capital structure for Chemicals. The chemicals business is expected to be spun-off on or before October 1, 1997.
The chemicals business had 1996 pro forma revenues of $2.98 billion.
